body.justification: Embedding the collision submodel into the paper's causal anchor makes the maximal valid transfer explicit: minimax converse bounds pass to every containing class by restriction.
body.gap: The collision constructions establish upper bounds only on the deterministic-array experiment; subclass monotonicity gives lower bounds, but not upper bounds or equalities, on broader anchor-admissible classes.
body.consumer: The result lets \(\texttt{causalPIviaCOT}\) treat the collision frontier as a certified obstruction for any analysis class containing the finite-grid stress test while retaining the narrower interpolation-only achievability scope.
